messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — noticed a weird behaviour in auto-fallback when we hit quota throttles. The runtime backfills requests after a short grace window, which causes duplicate fallback decisions in the audit log. Anyone seen this? :thinking:
sri: Hmm, do you mean the case where the policy fires 'soft_degrade' then the quota frees up and it fires again immediately?
elena: Yep. I saw a spike where the same request id ended up with two degrade entries. The console shows both as separate events.
tomas: Can you paste the sequence? Logs usually show the decision trace id.
morgan: Pasted minimal trace below — notice decision_tag X appears twice:```trace_id=tr.12345 event=soft_degrade reason=latency quota=burst0 -> timestamp=2025-11-02T14:22:03Z trace_id=tr.12345 event=soft_degrade reason=quota_backfill quota=burst0 -> timestamp=2025-11-02T14:22:06Z```
sri: That suggests we treat quota_backfill as an independent trigger even if the decision is identical. We should dedupe by (trace_id, decision_class) before emitting to the audit stream.
elena: Dedupe is fine but we also care about why it happened — losing the backfill signal would hide useful telemetry. Maybe tag the second event as "reaffirmation" instead of a full new decision?
tomas: Agreed. New event types: `initial`, `reaffirmation`, `override`. `reaffirmation` would be lightweight and not create a new rollback window in the console UI.
morgan: UX concern: the rollout timeline should not show multiple toggles for the same request. Reaffirmation should render inline and not increment the flip count.
sri: Implementation idea: emit both events with `decision_level` metadata: `0` for initial, `1` for reaffirmation. Console filters flips by `decision_level==0` for the visual flip counter.
elena: Also need to decide retention and sampling — reaffirmations should be sampled at a higher rate (e.g., 10%) to save storage but flagged for debug.
tomas: For backfill edgecases, add an idempotency token to the policy evaluator: if (trace_id, decision_class) seen within Xs, mark as reaffirmation. Xs configurable per policy.
morgan: Who owns the change? I can prototype the audit shim. Need console wiring too — @elena can you sketch the UI change to hide reaffirmations from flip counts?
elena: Yep, I'll put a tiny mock in Figma and link. Also thinking: show a subtle chevron if there were reaffirmations so operators can expand to see them.
sri: Ops notes: the ingestion pipeline currently groups events by trace_id but doesn't apply semantic dedupe. I can add a fast-path to mark duplicates and set `event_type=reaffirmation` before indexing. Will push a patch and feature flag it.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: staging rollout queued. To deploy sri/audit-dedupe -> staging, run `/deploy sri/audit-dedupe staging`.
morgan: Thanks. Action items: 1) morgan prototype audit shim (due EOD), 2) sri implement ingestion dedupe + feature flag (PR), 3) elena mock console UX (link in thread), 4) tomas add idempotency token to evaluator (small API change). I'll open a brief RFC for the event taxonomy.
elena: One last thought — we should ensure alerts don't fire on reaffirmations (false positives). I'll add that to the mock.
sri: Will add unit tests ensuring `reaffirmation` doesn't increment flip metrics.
morgan: Great. Filing follow-up RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2025/decision-audit-reaffirmation (will update with PR links). Thanks all :thumbsup:
